# Mailer

Set `SENDGRID_API_KEY` in your environment. A key looks like
`@@sample:S[G][.]X[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[.]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]XX[X]X@@`.

```
export SENDGRID_API_KEY=SG.your_api_key_goes_here.replace_this_with_the_actual_secret_you_got
```
